title: SwarmSubstratePluginConfig
description: Operator-overridable config for @mnmal-ai/swarm-substrate-plugin. Substrate's loader merges default-config.json with <SUBSTRATE_PLUGIN_DIR>/swarm.config.json. Informational: the bootstrap's zod schema is the validator.

scope.description: Required, no default. Which namespaces this instance owns: 'cold' serves <namespace> and <namespace>-docs, 'meta' serves <namespace>_meta, 'combined' serves all three.

namespace.description: The swarm namespace (SwarmConfig, SwarmContent, SwarmRoute, WorkerResult, ReviewVerdict, ArbiterDecision, SessionEvent, OversightChain, TranscriptEntry, Goal, TaskExecution, LearningEntry, McpServer, FailurePostmortem, Observation). The docs namespace is <namespace>-docs and the meta namespace <namespace>_meta.

contextNamespace.description: The context-store namespace observations are promoted into.

drainstopIntervalMs.description: How often the drainstop promotes and expires observations, in milliseconds.
